'THE PH WILL CONTINUE TO ASSERT ITS SOVEREIGNTY, SOVEREIGN RIGHTS, AND JURISDICTION IN THE WPS'

Ikinabahala ang National Maritime Council ang nangyaring pangha-harass ng China sa West Philippine Sea na nauwi sa banggaan ng dalawang Chinese ships.

"The Philippines renews its call for Chinese authorities to exercise self restraint, maintain safety of navigation, and refrain from conducting aggressive and dangerous maneuvers against Philippine vessels on routine operations within its own maritime zones," anila.
